relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: pointing to a deramified, activated phenotype of microglial cells in the LPBN following a systemic inflammatory challenge

key_findings: CCI caused strong GFAP and Iba1 upregulation and microglial activation in the ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn, peaking at 1 week.
CCI did not alter astrocytes or microglia in the LPBN at any time point, although systemic LPS did change LPBN microglia morphology.
